title: Matrices repeat a job
summary: A matrix runs variations of a job. Each combination gets its own job run.
introduction: A matrix runs variations of a job. Each combination gets its own job run. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

steps:
